claims.claim: Under the SOP's Day 1 rule, if snack_box passes while ep20 fails the problem is attributed to our data, and if both fail the recipe and environment are checked first and no batch training starts.
The 1M-buffer snack_box run failed its pre-registered criteria, and its pre-registration states that such a failure cannot separate a recipe problem from a buffer problem.
Upstream provides neither reference metrics nor a downloadable trained checkpoint for the G1 snack-box sample, and it states the full G1 training reproduction still needed sign-off.
The planned full-recipe snack_box run differs from the official G1 recipe only in logging, W&B naming and output directory, with no unexpected differences and no training overrides.
The training-path scripts show no differences from the commit used for the Day 1 training runs.
The per-frame rotation analysis passed all of its synthetic-data checks, including robustness to per-frame jitter and to quaternion sign flips.
The planned snack_box run uses 2048 worlds.
The planned snack_box run overrides the replay buffer capacity to 1,000,000.
